pokemon_scp.name: Dugtrio
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0051 is to be contained in a triple‑layer subterranean vault with seismic dampeners and reinforced flooring. All soil within the chamber must be replaced weekly with compacted, non‑burrowable substrate. Personnel must avoid standing directly above SCP-0051 at any time.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0051 consists of three linked entities sharing a single subterranean body. It can generate violent tremors capable of destabilizing reinforced structures. Ground penetration occurs at anomalous speeds, leaving no detectable tunnel behind.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly aggressive when disturbed. Displays coordinated movement and synchronized vocalizations.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0051-A: SCP-0051 caused a localized quake that damaged two adjacent containment wings.
Addendum 0051-B: Thermal scans suggest SCP-0051’s true body extends far deeper than previously estimated.

pokemon_scp.name: Meowth
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0052 is to be contained in a standard mammalian chamber with reinforced storage lockers. All valuable objects must be kept out of SCP-0052’s reach.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0052 is a feline organism with anomalous attraction to reflective or valuable objects. Capable of walking silently on any surface, including vertical walls. Foreclaws show micro‑serrations capable of slicing through thin metal.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Clever and mischievous. Frequently attempts to steal equipment.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0052-A: SCP-0052 bypassed a biometric lock by mimicking guard hand movements.
Addendum 0052-B: SCP-0052 hoarded 37 unauthorized items beneath its bedding.

pokemon_scp.name: Persian
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0053 is to be contained in a reinforced feline vault with motion‑tracking lasers. Personnel must avoid direct eye contact. All containment staff must undergo reflex training.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0053 is a large feline organism with extreme agility and predatory instincts. Its forehead gem emits low‑frequency pulses capable of inducing disorientation and fear.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly territorial. Displays calculated stalking behavior and coordinated ambush tactics.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0053-A: SCP-0053 incapacitated three guards in under 12 seconds.
Addendum 0053-B: Gem pulses caused panic attacks in exposed personnel.

pokemon_scp.name: Psyduck
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0054 is to be contained in a water‑enriched chamber with migraine‑monitoring equipment. Personnel must avoid startling SCP-0054.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0054 experiences chronic cranial pressure that triggers bursts of uncontrolled psychic energy. These bursts can disrupt electronics and cause mild telekinetic events.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Confused and lethargic. Psychic output increases when SCP-0054 is stressed.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0054-A: A psychic burst caused levitation of nearby objects for 14 seconds.
Addendum 0054-B: SCP-0054’s headaches correlate with lunar cycles.

pokemon_scp.name: Golduck
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0055 is to be contained in a deep aquatic vault with psychic dampeners. Personnel must not enter the water under any circumstances.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0055 exhibits advanced psychic abilities, including telekinesis, hydrokinesis, and limited mind‑reading. Capable of generating water blades sharp enough to cut reinforced steel.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but unpredictable. Displays strategic intelligence and awareness of containment protocols.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0055-A: SCP-0055 intercepted a guard’s thoughts during a breach drill.
Addendum 0055-B: Water blade attack severed a titanium anchor cable.

pokemon_scp.name: Mankey
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0056 is to be contained in a reinforced primate chamber with shock‑absorbent walls. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-0056.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0056 is a primate organism with extreme aggression and rapid reflexes. Capable of delivering strikes faster than human reaction time.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0056-A: SCP-0056 shattered a reinforced window with a single strike.
Addendum 0056-B: Heart rate spikes precede aggression by 0.3 seconds.

pokemon_scp.name: Primeape
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0057 is to be contained in a titan‑grade combat vault with automated tranquilizer turrets. Personnel must not enter without full riot armor.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0057 exhibits uncontrollable rage cycles and superhuman strength. Capable of bending steel bars and breaking reinforced restraints.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Constantly agitated. Rage cycles intensify when SCP-0057 is observed directly.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0057-A: SCP-0057 broke a tungsten restraint during a rage event.
Addendum 0057-B: Rage cycles appear to synchronize with nearby emotional states.

pokemon_scp.name: Growlithe
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0058 is to be housed in a fire‑resistant canine chamber. Personnel may interact with SCP-0058 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0058 is a canine organism capable of producing controlled flames. Displays strong loyalty toward familiar personnel.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Friendly and obedient. Uses fire bursts defensively.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0058-A: SCP-0058 produced a flame burst to protect a researcher.
Addendum 0058-B: Fur samples show mild heat resistance.

pokemon_scp.name: Arcanine
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0059 is to be contained in a heat‑shielded vault with flame‑dampening systems. Personnel must maintain a minimum distance of 20 meters.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0059 is a large canine organism capable of generating extreme flames and running at anomalous speeds. Heat output can melt reinforced steel.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Majestic but aggressive when challenged. Displays territorial dominance.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0059-A: SCP-0059 melted a containment gate during a sprint.
Addendum 0059-B: Flame output increases when SCP-0059 is observed directly.

pokemon_scp.name: Poliwag
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0060 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic enclosure with gentle currents. Personnel may interact with SCP-0060 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0060 is a small amphibious organism with a spiral pattern on its abdomen. The pattern induces mild hypnotic effects when observed for extended periods.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Playful and curious. Uses tail propulsion to move rapidly.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0060-A: A researcher reported dizziness after staring at SCP-0060’s spiral.
Addendum 0060-B: SCP-0060 created water ripples forming geometric shapes.
